name: Hendl König Imst
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Hendl König Imst in Imst

** **

** Welcome to **Hendl König Imst** – your traditional **Tirol** tavern in the heart of **Imst**, where hearty **Tiroler** cuisine meets cozy atmosphere. Since 1987, we’ve been serving up the finest **Hendl** (roast chicken) in the region, slow-roasted to golden perfection with aromatic herbs and crispy skin. Every piece is tender, juicy, and bursting with flavor—just the way **Oma** used to make it! Our menu is a celebration of **Tirol’s** culinary treasures. Start with a bowl of creamy **Käsespätzle** or a fresh **Tiroler Gröstl**, then dive into our legendary **Hendl** served with classic sides like **Kartoffelsalat**, **Rotkohl**, or **Semmelknödel**. For dessert, indulge in a fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn** with warm apple compote or a rich **Apfelstrudel**—the perfect sweet finish to your meal. We take pride in using the freshest, locally sourced ingredients, from our **Hendl** to our **Tiroler Bergkäse** and crisp **Tiroler Speck**. Whether you’re here for a quick lunch, a leisurely dinner, or a cold **Tiroler Bier** with friends, **Hendl König Imst** is your go-to spot for authentic **Tiroler** flavors in the most welcoming setting. **Come see why we’re a local favorite—just a short drive from Innsbruck and the stunning **Zillertal**!** **

** **Prost und an Guadn!** (Cheers and enjoy!)
